voice.welcome: Welcome, family reporter! Pick a picture to find your first question.
voice.choose: Pick a question, or let the surprise button choose for you.
voice.surprise: Surprise question! Let's see which family memory we find.
voice.topic-childhood: When you were little. Ask about a long-ago childhood memory.
voice.topic-favorites: Favorite things. Ask about something your grown-up really loved.
voice.topic-traditions: Family traditions. Ask about something your family did together.
voice.q-childhood-game: What game did you love to play when you were little?
voice.q-childhood-laugh: What made you laugh when you were my age?
voice.q-childhood-school: What was a school day like when you were little?
voice.q-favorite-toy: What was your favorite toy as a child?
voice.q-favorite-food: What food did you love when you were little?
voice.q-favorite-story: What song or story did you ask for again and again?
voice.q-tradition-happy: What family tradition made you feel happy?
voice.q-tradition-celebrate: How did your family celebrate a special day?
voice.q-tradition-together: What did everyone do together when you were little?
voice.ready-record: Ask your grown-up the question. Then tap the coral microphone when they are ready to share.
voice.recording: I'm listening. Tap again when the story is finished.
voice.recorded: Story captured! You can listen, or decorate your memory page.
voice.mic-fallback: That's okay. Tell the story together, and we can still make a beautiful memory page.
voice.decorate: Add a family photo if you want, then pick a sticker for your page.
voice.photo-added: Photo added. Your memory page is coming together.
voice.saved: Story saved in your family memory book!
voice.book-empty: Your memory book is ready for its first family story.
voice.book-open: Here are your family stories. Tap a page to hear one again.
voice.storage-fallback: Your page is safe for this play time. This device could not keep it after you leave.
voice.nudge: Your grown-up can take all the time they need. Tap the microphone when you're ready.
